rektion: in etw. (Dat.) untertauchen; jdn. untertauchen (hat); fig.: im Ausland / bei Freunden untertauchen
meaning_en: to dive under, to go under (water); fig.: to go into hiding, to disappear for a while
definition_de: unter die Wasseroberfläche gehen; übertragen: sich verstecken oder sich eine Zeit lang aus der Öffentlichkeit zurückziehen (Nach dem Überfall ist der Täter untergetaucht.)
example_de: Der Junge holte tief Luft, hielt sich die Nase zu und tauchte im See unter.
example_en: The boy took a deep breath, held his nose and dived under in the lake.
user_example_de: Ich bin eine Weile untergetaucht, um neue Kraft und Ideen zu sammeln.
visual_idea: Literal collocation 'im Wasser untertauchen': an over-under shot splits the frame at the waterline, so the boy is visibly below the surface (unter-) with bubbles marking where he just went down. The figurative 'disappear for a while' builds on this picture. Video recommended (going under).
image_prompt: a split-level over-under view of a calm clear lake in summer, the waterline crossing the middle of the frame; above the water a sunny shore with pine trees and a wooden jetty, below the water a boy of about ten fully submerged just under the surface, eyes closed, cheeks puffed, pinching his nose, a trail of silver air bubbles rising to the rippling spot where he went under
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_start_prompt: a split-level over-under view of a calm clear lake in summer, the waterline crossing the middle of the frame; above the water a sunny shore with pine trees and a wooden jetty, a boy of about ten standing chest-deep in the water, head above the surface, taking a deep breath with puffed cheeks, his legs visible below the waterline
video_prompt: a boy standing chest-deep in a clear lake takes a deep breath, pinches his nose and slowly sinks down until his head disappears under the surface, silver bubbles rising where he went under; split-level over-under view, static camera, calm water
